title: nematolepis squamea
intro: Nematolepis squamea, commonly known as Spiny Rutty Pine, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rutaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of conditions such as arthritis and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Nematolepis squamea include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiseptic actions, making it a potential treatment for infections and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and make it a subject of interest in modern pharmacology.
